info.name: Cvent REST APIs — Event Cloud Card Tokens API

items.docs: Creates a short-lived token representing a credit card. This token replaces the credit card in API methods. It can be used multiple times within a 15-minute time-to-live (TTL) period. After 15 minutes, the token will expire and can no longer be used. If the same credit card is needed to perform additional API methods after the 15-minute TTL, the card will need to be resubmitted for another short-lived token.
